text:
Everything you learned about women came from broke men.

Your broke friends said money doesn't matter. Your father maybe said chasing it was empty.

They were covering for their own failure.

A woman reads your discipline. Your direction. Your ability to build and protect something. She reads that in how you handle money.

Not consciously. Biologically. She's looking for a partner who can handle a life.

Start today. Build income. Save monthly. Commit.

The man who does this doesn't need to convince anyone. His life convinces them.
caption:
Your broke role models won't admit they failed. Their failure isn't your fate.
Send this to a man who needs it today.
#mindset #discipline #success #dating #selfimprovement
